answer: The grove of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The lotus is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the opal. Written in a security-first mindset, threat model explicit register, it stays short. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution.
